name: dnsfilter-mcp
description: Every DNSFilter API operation, plus one-command answers to 'why is this site blocked for this client' and 'which clients are behind on the roaming agent'.

dnsfilter_base_url.title: DNSFilter API base URL
dnsfilter_base_url.description: Optional. Leave blank for the DNSFilter API (https://api.dnsfilter.com).

dnsfilter_api_key.title: DNSFILTER_API_KEY
dnsfilter_api_key.description: DNSFilter API token (DNSFilter dashboard, Account Settings, API Tokens). Use the bare token: DNSFilter expects it as the Authorization header value with no Bearer prefix. Create it in your MSP organization so the cross-client commands see your client organizations.

dnsfilter_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
dnsfilter_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

dnsfilter_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
dnsfilter_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 so the MCP server offers only tools that read from DNSFilter: write tools are removed, and reads that return a secret (site secret keys, API key tokens, the roaming client uninstall PIN) are refused. Leave blank for the full tool set.

dnsfilter_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP bearer token
dnsfilter_mcp_http_token.description: Only for --transport http: the bearer token callers must present. Not used by Claude Desktop (stdio). Leave blank.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not enforced by this connector: there are no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here does not limit which organizations a call can reach. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, use a narrower API token or turn on the read-only MCP server.
